history:
Church Hill Junior School Drama Club
Members of the Drama Club at Church Hill Junior School in 1974. This photograph was taken by Mr. Keith Wilson who was a teacher at the school between 1970 and 1976 and ran the Drama Club which met on Monday night after school. This picture shows the cast of ‘The Sun’, which was about a group of children who had found a piece of the sun which had fallen out of the sky. The children wrote the play themselves and a short film was made of the play.
